verdict.rationale: First-party docs make natural-language operation the core interaction model. The CLI lets you "edit, orchestrate, and build all in natural language", the Editor offers natural language code commands, and spoken prompts are transcribed into instructions. Agents act on those instructions across editor, terminal and browser, and you can steer them with inline text feedback on Artifacts. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that specifically confirms NL command quality (community reports only say the CLI "works fine"), and NL control of product configuration, which is documented via slash commands and settings menus instead.
